description: Reads the questions participants asked in the live console: the open (unanswered) and the answered ones, each with its question id, the text, the attendee's name, the time and the state. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks what people are asking, which questions are still open, or before answering one (that is wi_answer_webinar_question) or deleting one (that is wi_delete_webinar_question). The question id from this answer is the one to pass on, never an invented one. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

limit.description: How many questions to return, 1-200. Default 50.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_get_webinar_questions
title: Read the questions of the live webinar
